item.title: Shortwave Radiogram, 8-15 October 2026 (program 470): Digital modes for the ships that must detour around the Panama Canal
item.description:
I think Shortwave Radiogram will transmit normally this week. Last week, during the first transmission Thursday at 2330 UTC, the images did not decode for most listeners. However, Bobby in Louisiana and Tobias in Germany knew immediately what the problem was. The Fldigi Rv (reverse) button was inadvertently activated while I produced program 469. They knew the solution: simply use the Rv button while decoding.

Anyway, to eliminate the drama, I recorded program 469 again without the Rv for the second WINB transmission and for the WRMI airplays.

The Fldigi Rv (reverse) button is mostly used for RTTY, which must be encoded in USB, but in some cases is received in LSB. I don’t know why Rv would even be an option for the MFSK modes.  

Autumn is here. It brings nice weather and generally good HF conditions. Autumn also supplies us with photos of leaves changing colors. You’ll decode plenty of those in the next few weeks, and probably also see some in person.

A video of last week’s Shortwave Radiogram (program 469) is provided by Scott in Ontario (Wednesday 1330 UTC). The audio archive is maintained by Mark in the UK. Analysis (explaining the Rv problem) is provided by Roger in Germany.

Here is the lineup for Shortwave Radiogram, program 470, 8-15 October 2026, in MFSK modes as noted:

 1:42  MFSK32: Program preview
 2:54  MFSK32: Ship detour around Panama Canal due to drought
 6:21  MFSK64: Solar boom rapidly transforming emerging economies
12:18  MFSK64: This week’s images
27:54  MFSK32: Closing announcements

item.title: Shortwave Radiogram, 1-8 October 2026 (program 469): Off to a rocky start
item.description:
I go away for two weeks, and I forget how to produce the show. The transmission of program 469 will be largely unsuccessful –Thursday 2330-2400 UTC on 9265 kHz from WINB Pennsylvania – due to technical problems in my studio that I did not discover until it was too late.

I hope a correct recording of program 469 can be transmitted by WINB UTC Saturday 0230-0300, also on 9265 kHz. 

The WRMI transmissions should be OK.

Al Holt and Tony Pavick did not have technical difficulties. During my absence, they presented two excellent Shortwave Radiograms featuring rail travel posters. If you missed them, there is information below about how to access the YouTube recordings provided by Scott in Toronto. 

Thanks also to Marty Pittinger KB3MXM for taking care of the reminders and reposts on Bluesky and X while I was gone. 

Videos of Al and Tony’s Shortwave Radiograms, program 467 and program 468, are provided by Scott in Toronto  (Wednesday 1330 UTC). The audio archive is maintained by Mark in the UK. Analysis of programs 467 and 468 is provided by Roger in Germany. Also: an IQ file and other resources from H0B0-Radio in Washington state. And John Rabold’s image archive.

Here is the lineup for Shortwave Radiogram, program 469, 1-8 October 2026, in MFSK modes as noted:
